name: exam-builder
description: Build exam papers from your own question bank (Markdown or Excel, with LaTeX formulas and images): the bank is checked for missing answers, missing images, formula errors and duplicates; papers are drawn by section, chapter and difficulty ratio, with several non-overlapping sets (A/B) from a fixed seed; you can swap single questions. Exports print-ready A4 PDFs with vector formulas plus separate answer keys, and HTML. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

description_i18n.en: Build exam papers from your own question bank (Markdown or Excel, with LaTeX formulas and images): the bank is checked for missing answers, missing images, formula errors and duplicates; papers are drawn by section, chapter and difficulty ratio, with several non-overlapping sets (A/B) from a fixed seed; you can swap single questions. Exports print-ready A4 PDFs with vector formulas plus separate answer keys, and HTML. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用自己的题库（Markdown 或 Excel，支持 LaTeX 公式和图片）组卷：先检查缺答案、缺图、公式错误和重复题；按题型、章节和难度比例抽题，可出多套互不重复的 A/B 卷（种子固定、可复现），单题可替换。导出可直接打印的 A4 PDF（公式为矢量）和单独的答案册，以及 HTML。全部本地处理，不上传。
